data.title: Greg Abbott Says AI Data Centers ‘Dug Their Own Grave’ as Backlash Over Power Bills, Water Use and Local Development Explodes
data.description: Texas Gov. Greg Abbott (R) is taking a harder line on AI data centers as growing public opposition forces politicians to confront concerns over electricity, water, infrastructure and local development...
data.keywords: Greg Abbott, data centers, Donald Trump, electricity demand, power grid, local development, Texas, environmental impacts, infrastructure
